card.name: The word until after a state
card.fires_on: The word "until" right after a clause describing something that continues or persists, such as a risk that may persist until remission. It also fires on a stray digit in a date stamp.

modes.label: Until after persisting
modes.description: "until" follows a verb phrase saying something stays or holds, and introduces the end point.
modes.example: this risk may persist<< until>> significant remission occurs.

modes.label: Until in code documentation
modes.description: "until" ends a clause about a value staying set before a later change.
modes.example: explicitly stated to be set and<< until>> it is changed by the next function call

card.writes: It pushes the model away from words meaning "after" (including Chinese equivalents), favoring an "until" reading of the time relation.
card.plain: It marks the word "until" when it sets the end point of something that continues, and steers away from "after".
evidence: whether or not they are taking antidepressant medications, and this risk may persist<< until>> significant remission occurs.
